title: Fairy Lights in Femtoseconds: Tangible Holographic Plasma (SIGGRAPH)
summary: A SIGGRAPH demo from Yoichi Ochiai's group of aerial and volumetric graphics drawn by focused femtosecond lasers with computational holography. The plasma points can be touched.
why: Linked as the demo behind femtosecond plasma displays, often noting the touch burns skin and the system is loud.
